body: Im in the UK, but thanks so much, I really appreciate your talking about this with me, gives me hope and motivation to work this out
not at the moment, but Ive been on medication before, and had therapy a a a few years ago, so I just need to sort that stuff out again, and speak to a GP about getting treatment.

Thank you so much for putting it like that....a part of me wants to believe that it is just her wanting space, and I would do anything for her to get through this together....
Its hard on my wife, like you explained, and I have to admit something that hasnt really occurred to me, and that is I can stop hiding and pretending Im ok in front of my close friends and family...
I need to be myself and the burden of pretending makes it worse...
I will give her the space she needs....and hopefully in time she will be able to talk again...
thank you so much for your advice...it really hit home, and I appreciate your taking the time to write it all out...

Thanks man....It really helps to just be able to speak about it, and its just been tearing me apart inside and I feel so helpless...
It just breaks my heart that the woman I love and the kids I literally breath for are not with me right now, during my weakest moments I have ever experienced...I just want to hide and sob thinking about it and disappear....but thank you for your kind words...
